crew.overview: A five-year-old Indian boy gets lost on the streets of Calcutta, thousands of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before being adopted by a couple in Australia; 25 years later, he sets out to find his lost family.
crew.title: Lion

details.biography:
Garth Davis (born 1974) is an Australian television, advertising, and film director, best known for directing the films Lion (2016) and biblical drama Mary Magdalene (2018). He directed episodes of Top of the Lake (2013) earlier.
